description: Orchestration contract for deterministic unified regression review and policy coverage analysis
objective: Review a change with business-flow awareness, run targeted regression tests, evaluate policy coverage, and return actionable findings.

questionTriggers: missing changed files and no git history
ambiguous business intent that changes review outcome

multiAgentRoles.focus: code quality, reliability, maintainability, security and integration risks
business flow correctness, UX impact, and side effects on onboarding/offboarding/profile/permissions
deterministic selection and execution of relevant Playwright specs
merge findings into a single prioritized recommendation set

deterministicWorkflow.purpose: load conceptual and product policy checks used by product-flow reviewer
produce one deterministic combined output that includes regression execution, policy coverage analysis, and overall risk
